title: Hero Intro (JD-style reference)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: A dark, heavy, swaggering modern South Indian mass hero introduction score, 35 seconds, built for a slow-motion hero entry. Electronic and bass-led: a deep, sustained 808 sub-bass that holds long notes, dark processed synth stabs hitting every two beats, gritty distorted textures and unique processed sound design. Very bass-heavy and dark in tone, little high end. One steady tempo, 99 BPM, in E minor with a raised seventh (E F# G A B C D#). ONE original, menacing 4-bar hook (about 10 seconds long) runs through the whole track: E G A B, A G F# D# E, played on a dark synth lead with raga-style bends and slides, coming back bigger every time and climbing an octave at the peak. Written the way today's South Indian film composers score a mass hero entry: swagger, stop-and-slam full-band hits, a male wordless chant answering the hook, a korvai-style ending. Electronic leads; a real mridangam and a plucked veena are the second layer, played close, dry and natural, no heavy echo, not chopped. 0-2 s: quiet, a low drone and a reversed swell. 2-12 s: slam in with the 808 sub, the stabs every two beats and mridangam; the synth lead plays the hook. 12-21 s: the hook again, louder; a deep male wordless chant answers each phrase; the veena plucks a counter-line. 21-22 s: one rising sweep and a half-second stop. 22-32 s: the peak: the hook an octave higher, full male choir chant, doubled drums, brass-like synth stabs. 32-35 s: three slamming full-band hits and a final deep boom that rings out. No soft long intro, no fade-out, no EDM drop, no side-chain pumping, no white-noise risers, no lyrics.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 14:27 uploaded 'Master - JD Intro Bgm.mp3' and asked for a track like it. Measured with music/tools/analyze.py + deep.py (numbers in script). Built on the hero rules: electronic leads, one Carnatic instrument as 2nd/3rd layer, steady sub (no pumping), 4-bar theme repeated bigger, korvai ending. 2 takes; we pick.

story: A 35-second mass hero intro: darkness, a slow tease, then the hero walks in on a heavy dark groove that keeps getting bigger until a three-hit ending.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
